text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh, actually, this show I watched the 
other day...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Ahaha! No way~! Just remembering 
it makes me burst out laughing again~~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Of all episodes, it was a legendary 
10-cushion smash hit! I can't sleep at all 
because I keep bursting into giggles 
remembering it...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The Master of Comedy is truly a 
terrifying force.

Nice Nature enjoyed her day off a little 
too much... and ended up sleep-deprived.
